steps.title: Prepare microscope slides
steps.instruction: Using a PAP pen, draw circles 1–1.5 cm in diameter on each microscope slide (two circles per slide fit with 22 × 22 mm cover slips). Allow the circles to dry overnight (or at least 2 h in a laminar flow hood).

steps.title: Maintain and prepare male worms
steps.instruction: Grow the required strains and obtain 30–40 males for the sperm‑number assay and ≥5 males per replicate for the other assays. Four to five days before the assay, transfer young adult males and hermaphrodites to fresh NGM plates at a 3:1 male:herm ratio. If male fertility is low, mate males to hermaphrodites (3:1) overnight on NGM plates seeded with 20 µl of 25× OP50‑1, then return them to stock plates. Use smaller food spots to increase male–herm encounters. For larger numbers, synchronize populations by alkaline hypochlorite treatment and select populations that are ~50 % male. Pick L4 virgin males to stock NGM plates free of hermaphrodites the day before the assay (L4 stage prevents premature activation). If performing the qualitative mitochondrial morphology assay, apply MitoTracker dye to the food beforehand (see step 6). To prevent males from leaving plates, briefly let gravid, unmated hermaphrodites crawl on the seeded NGM to scent it, then remove them before transferring males. Incubate the prepared males for 18–24 h at 20 °C.

steps.title: Sperm number assay
steps.instruction: Wash isolated males in 1.5 ml tubes with PBS + 0.01 % Triton X‑100 (PBST). Centrifuge 1 min at 560 × g, remove supernatant to 0.1 ml mark. Wash 1–2 additional times with PBST until the supernatant is clear (do not over‑wash). After the final wash, centrifuge again (1 min, 560 × g) and remove supernatant to 0.1 ml. Add 600 µl 40 % isopropanol, rotate 3 min at room temperature to fix. While fixing, prepare DAPI staining solution: dilute 1 mg ml⁻¹ DAPI stock to 10 µg ml⁻¹ in 40 % isopropanol (add 10 µl DAPI per 1 ml 40 % isopropanol). Centrifuge fixed worms (1 min, 560 × g), remove supernatant to 0.1 ml, add 600 µl staining solution, incubate in the dark 5 min. Centrifuge (1 min, 560 × g), remove supernatant to 0.1 ml, add 600 µl PBST, incubate dark 30 min to destain. Mount the pellet on a regular microscope slide with Vectashield mounting medium, cover with a cover slip and seal edges with nail polish. Let dry in the dark 5–10 min. Image at 40–63× using DIC and DAPI filters; collect z‑stacks spanning the seminal vesicle with a z‑plane spacing of 0.25 µm (auto‑settings of Zeiss software).

steps.title: Sperm size assay
steps.instruction:
Clean males to remove E. coli (choose one method):
1) Pipet two ~15 µl drops of M9 onto a Petri‑dish lid, transfer 5 day‑one adult virgin males into the first drop, then use an eyelash brush to move them to the second drop before placing them in SM buffer on the prepared slide.
2) Transfer >5 day‑one adult virgin males onto an unseeded NGM plate, let them crawl off the food spot, then pick 5 males with a clean platinum pick onto SM buffer on the slide.
Pipet 35 µl SM buffer containing dextrose into the grease circle (from step 1). Transfer the 5 cleaned males onto the SM drop. Dissect each male by slicing between the midpoint and tail (≈1/3 body length from tail) with a scalpel or two crossed 25‑gauge needles; sterilize the instrument between samples by dipping in ≥70 % ethanol and flaming. Cover the released spermatids with a cover slip, seal with nail polish, and image immediately with a 100× objective using a DIC filter (complete imaging ≤5 min). Score only spherical cells, counting at least 100 spermatids per replicate.

steps.title: Sperm activation assay
steps.instruction:
Construct a humid chamber: place a wet paper towel at the bottom of a lidded container, cover with a sheet of parafilm to create a dry surface for slides, then replace the lid.
Prepare Pronase working solution (see Recipes) and SM buffer containing BSA with 400 ng µl⁻¹ Pronase by diluting 4 µl Pronase stock into 96 µl SM‑BSA.
Clean males as described in step 4.
Pipet 35 µl SM‑BSA into the grease circle on the slide (from step 1) and transfer 5 cleaned males onto the drop.
Dissect the males as in step 4.
After the final male is dissected, add 35 µl SM‑BSA + 400 ng µl⁻¹ Pronase to the sample.
Incubate the slide in the sealed humid chamber for 15 min.
Prepare a cover slip by drawing a thin line of petroleum jelly around its edges with forceps or a pipette tip.
After incubation, place the petroleum‑jelly‑sealed cover slip over the sample (do not add nail polish). Image within 5 min using a 100× objective and DIC filter; acquire each field at two focal planes (lower magnification first, then oil immersion, without returning to low power). Score ≥100 spermatids per replicate.

steps.title: Qualitative mitochondrial morphology assay
steps.instruction:
Dilute MitoTracker stock (1 mM in DMSO) to 100 µM in M9. Add 50 µl of this working solution to the food spot of an NGM plate seeded with 50 µl of 25× OP50‑1 and let dry.
Transfer L4 males onto this prepared plate (using an eyelash brush or platinum pick as in step 4) and incubate 18–24 h at 20 °C.
Clean the males (step 4) and pipet 35 µl SM buffer containing dextrose into the grease circle on the slide.
Dissect the males as in step 4, cover the spermatids with a cover slip and seal with nail polish.
Image within 10 min using a 100× objective with DIC and AlexaFluor‑594 (RFP) filters. Score only spherical cells, ≥100 spermatids per replicate.

steps.title: Quantitative mitochondrial fusion assay
steps.instruction:
Prepare a humid chamber as in step 5.
Clean males (step 4).
Make JC‑1 staining solution: add 8 µl of 1.5 mM JC‑1 stock to 792 µl SM buffer containing BSA (final JC‑1 15 µM).
Pipet 35 µl of this SM‑BSA‑JC‑1 solution into the grease circle on the slide.
Transfer 5 cleaned virgin males onto the drop and dissect as in step 4.
After the final male is dissected, add 25 µl SM‑BSA‑JC‑1 to the sample and incubate in the sealed humid chamber for 10 min.
Wash the slide three times with 100 µl SM‑BSA (no JC‑1); avoid completely removing liquid or overflowing the grease circle (use 80–90 µl if needed).
Cover with a cover slip and seal with nail polish.
Image with a 100× objective using AlexaFluor‑488 (green) and AlexaFluor‑546 (red) channels; collect 8–9 z‑stack images spaced 0.8 µm. Complete imaging within 10 min. Score only spherical cells, ≥40 spermatids per replicate.

steps.title: Prepare NGM plates
steps.instruction:
Prepare 1 M stock solutions of MgSO₄ (120.366 g L⁻¹), cholesterol (5 g L⁻¹ in 100 % ethanol), KH₂PO₄ (136.086 g L⁻¹), CaCl₂ (110.98 g L⁻¹), and 2.5 % (w/v) streptomycin (25 g L⁻¹). Filter‑sterilize each.
In a glass flask add 3 g NaCl, 17 g agar, 2.5 g peptone and 950 ml water; cover with foil and autoclave. Cool to 55–60 °C, then add 1 ml 1 M MgSO₄, 1 ml 5 mg ml⁻¹ cholesterol, 25 ml 1 M KH₂PO₄, 1 ml 1 M CaCl₂, and 7.5 ml 2.5 % streptomycin. Stir 5 min. Dispense 11 ml into each 6 cm Petri dish and let solidify overnight.
Seed each plate with 250 µl OP50‑1 overnight culture (grown in LB + streptomycin, no shaking).

steps.title: Prepare PBS solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 26.5 g Na₂HPO₄·7H₂O, 80 g NaCl, 2 g KCl, and 2 g KH₂PO₄ in water, bring volume to 1 L, autoclave, and store.

steps.title: Prepare PBST solution
steps.instruction: Using a cut pipette tip, add 100 µl Triton X‑100 to 1 L sterile PBS, mix gently (do not shake).

steps.title: Prepare SM buffer (dextrose)
steps.instruction:
Prepare 1 M stock solutions of HEPES (238.3 g L⁻¹), NaCl (58.4 g L⁻¹), KCl (74.6 g L⁻¹), CaCl₂ (110.98 g L⁻¹), MgSO₄ (120.366 g L⁻¹), and dextrose (180.2 g L⁻¹); filter‑sterilize.
Combine 2.5 ml 1 M HEPES, 2.5 ml 1 M NaCl, 1.25 ml 1 M KCl, 250 µl 1 M CaCl₂, 50 µl 1 M MgSO₄, 500 µl 1 M dextrose, and ~20 ml water; adjust pH to 7.8, bring volume to 50 ml, filter‑sterilize, store at 4 °C. Bring aliquots to room temperature before use.

steps.title: Prepare SM buffer (BSA)
steps.instruction:
Prepare 1 M stock solutions of HEPES, NaCl, KCl, CaCl₂, MgSO₄ as above and a 5 % (w/v) BSA solution (2.5 g L⁻¹). Filter‑sterilize.
Combine 2.5 ml 1 M HEPES, 2.5 ml 1 M NaCl, 1.25 ml 1 M KCl, 250 µl 1 M CaCl₂, 50 µl 1 M MgSO₄, 1 ml 5 % BSA, and ~20 ml water; adjust pH to 7.8, bring volume to 50 ml, filter‑sterilize, store at 4 °C. Bring aliquots to room temperature before use.

steps.title: Prepare M9 buffer
steps.instruction: Add 30 g KH₂PO₄, 60 g Na₂HPO₄, 50 g NaCl, and 120 mg MgSO₄ to a glass bottle, bring volume to 1 L, autoclave. Note: calcium‑salt precipitation may occur; re‑dissolve by agitation over several days if needed.

steps.title: Prepare DAPI stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve DAPI to 1 mg ml⁻¹ in DMSO, protect from light, aliquot and store at –20 °C (freeze‑thaw cycles permissible).

steps.title: Prepare Pronase working solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve Pronase to 10 mg ml⁻¹ in water; make fresh before each use.

steps.title: Prepare MitoTracker stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve MitoTracker Red CMXRos to 1 mM (0.53152 g ml⁻¹) in DMSO, protect from light, aliquot and store at –20 °C; minimize freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Prepare JC-1 stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve JC‑1 to 1 mg ml⁻¹ (1.5 mM) in DMSO, protect from light, aliquot and store at –20 °C; minimize freeze‑thaw cycles.
